familyAnchors.sourceDefinition: Sharp Table 2 labels only 'on and off' and 'gray scales'; no threshold, direction, gray pair, temperature, or waveform is supplied.

runtimeResponseDefinition.name: project-equivalent 10-to-90 interval
runtimeResponseDefinition.scope: One common mathematical definition for all ensemble members and model candidates; it is not attributed to the Sharp source.
runtimeResponseDefinition.fullScaleReference: code 0 to 31 and 31 to 0 use the on-and-off anchor symmetrically
runtimeResponseDefinition.grayReference: adjacent middle transitions 15 to 16 and 16 to 15 use the gray-scales anchor symmetrically
runtimeResponseDefinition.uncertainty: The original threshold definition and gray pair are unavailable, so these are compatibility anchors rather than reproduced source waveforms.

state.units: dimensionless; not volts and not final luminance
state.settledColor: evaluate exact settled coordinates through the unchanged WS1 32-cubed D65 LUT

modelCandidates.scientificStatus: smallest monotone candidate compatible with the four family scalar anchors
plausible but direction split is unidentifiable because the source reports only combined on-and-off values
plausible delayed director/optical candidate, but an infinity of hidden-state fits share each scalar response time

criteria: monotone, finite, and bounded without unsupported overshoot
matches every declared family compatibility anchor under one response definition
fewest state and direction parameters compatible with accepted evidence
future per-cell measurements can replace rates without changing the state or Shader interface
rejectedFeatures: direction asymmetry without a directional source
second hidden state without a waveform
overdrive or overshoot without CGB evidence
channel multipliers without per-channel response data

rateField.identityCell: uses grayMs as a replaceable table value; the exact state==target fixed point bypasses rate evaluation

members.familyInterpretation: HCR-like endpoint; does not assert that the CGB is HCR
members.uncertainty: Source response definition and relationship to CGB are unknown.

members.familyInterpretation: arithmetic midpoint between the HCR-like and GH-like family bounds; not a measured typical CGB
members.uncertainty: Chosen only as a neutral period midpoint until CGB-specific data exists.

members.familyInterpretation: GH-like endpoint; does not assert that the CGB is GH
members.uncertainty: Source response definition and relationship to CGB are unknown.

specimenOverride.replacementRule: A valid measured cell replaces only the addressed rate and provenance; invalid or absent cells retain the reconstructed rate.
